name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair Davies's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working in a small engineering workshop after completing his apprenticeship, he caught the eye of a mechanic from a local racing team who was impressed by Alistair's meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving skills. He was offered a junior position and quickly proved his worth, mastering the intricacies of precision machining for high-performance vehicles. His pragmatic approach ensures that every component meets the exact specifications, contributing to both reliability and performance on the track.

Now at ART Grand Prix, Alistair excels in translating complex designs into tangible parts. He thrives on the challenge of creating components that can withstand extreme conditions and contribute to marginal gains. While not a natural leader, Alistair's dedication to precision and his quiet determination make him a valuable asset to the team. He believes in a no-nonsense approach to problem-solving, focusing on practical solutions and refusing to be swayed by hype or conjecture. Alistair's loyalty makes him a dependable presence in the garage.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical drawings and measurements.
Insists on cleaning his tools at the end of every shift, regardless of how busy he is.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on any surface when concentrating.
